name: Weather, Today
description: Today's weather as a column for a narrow (portrait) cell: the weather now with the day's high, low and rain, and below it every hour of the rest of the day with its icon, temperature and a bar for the rain. Hours gone by stay, faded. Open-Meteo, no key.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Place
cell_options.help: Search a town, or paste 'lat, lon'.

cell_options.name: label
cell_options.label: Place name
cell_options.help: Auto-filled from the place; shown under the date when set.

cell_options.name: from_hour
cell_options.label: Hours from
cell_options.help: The first hour in the list. Hours gone by stay, faded; when the list does not fit the cell, the earliest of those go first.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Language
cell_options.help: The widget's words in this language, whatever the dashboard's. Set the same on every widget of a page for one language throughout.
